matches_set.description: Compatible with: every MOR-37xx model, except MOR-3720. The Latch C2 is a sleek, keyless deadbolt designed to elevate any unit entry. With a clean, modern profile and simple installation, the C2 fits most standard doors and is well-suited for both new construction and retrofit projects. It eliminates the risk of unauthorized rekeying by removing physical keys entirely. Residents and staff can unlock using the DOOR App, keycard, personalized Doorcodes, Android NFC, or . The C2 features a smooth manual thumbturn in place of a motorized deadbolt, reducing the risk of jamming and improving battery life, all while delivering a more intuitive locking experience.
